properties.summary: Land-use designations of the adopted Mare Island Specific Plan (1999, amended and restated 2005, amended through 2013), traced from its Figure 3.1 Land Use (revised January 2008) in the City of Vallejo's posted plan graphics, and clipped to the adopted plan area from City GIS. White industrial and wetland areas are told apart by the plan's Reuse Area lines; medium and low density housing are one zone because the scan doesn't separate them; the retail/commercial asterisks (point symbols) and the diagrammatic building masses aren't drawn. Federal transfer land (Army Reserve, Forest Service) is shown but isn't subject to the plan. The Mare Island Company's new specific plan is still a draft under City review and isn't drawn. All boundaries are approximate.
properties.note: Land-use zones of the adopted 1999-2013 specific plan; a new plan is in City review. Approximate zones, not buildings.

controls.label: figure building-mass edges vs Overture building outlines: trimmed RMS over the closest 50% of 3052 points

fit.init: A Street and G Street at Railroad Avenue (OpenStreetMap via Overture)

georeference.note: Figure building masses fitted to Overture/OpenStreetMap building outlines by trimmed ICP from two street intersections: about 2.62 m per render pixel, trimmed RMS 11 m (median 22 m over all points). Zones are clipped to the site boundary (City of Vallejo GIS layer 67).

properties.license: Zone shapes: traced from the City of Vallejo's public Mare Island Specific Plan graphics. Georeference: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL 1.0), via Overture Maps.

properties.label: Mixed-use
properties.source: traced: Mare Island Specific Plan graphics (11x17 figures), City of Vallejo, Figure 3.1 Land Use (revised January 2008), PDF p. 9
properties.note: Office/R&D, light industrial, retail commercial and warehousing; residential uses are also allowed (plan §3.2.8, PDF p. 76). Reuse Areas 2A (Town Center, with a 50,000 sq ft retail centre at Railroad Avenue and G Street), 2B, 3A and 3B (§3.3.2, PDF p. 81). About 202 acres as drawn inside the site. Adopted plan's designation; approximate, traced from a scanned figure.

properties.label: Historic core
properties.source: traced: Mare Island Specific Plan graphics (11x17 figures), City of Vallejo, Figure 3.1 Land Use (revised January 2008), PDF p. 9
properties.note: Reuse Area 4: civic, retail and office commercial, light industrial and visitor uses in historic buildings, with a waterfront plaza (plan §3.3.3 and §3.5.7, PDF pp. 81-82, 100-101). Category mixed-use. About 28 acres as drawn inside the site. Adopted plan's designation; approximate, traced from a scanned figure.

properties.label: Residential high density
properties.source: traced: Mare Island Specific Plan graphics (11x17 figures), City of Vallejo, Figure 3.1 Land Use (revised January 2008), PDF p. 9
properties.note: Less than 2,500 sq ft of land per home, more than 17.4 homes per acre (plan §3.2.7, PDF p. 74). About 21 acres as drawn inside the site. Adopted plan's designation; approximate, traced from a scanned figure.

properties.label: Residential medium and low density
properties.source: traced: Mare Island Specific Plan graphics (11x17 figures), City of Vallejo, Figure 3.1 Land Use (revised January 2008), PDF p. 9
properties.note: The figure's medium (8.7-17.4 homes per acre) and low (under 8.7 homes per acre) density shades (plan §3.2.7, PDF pp. 74-75) can't be told apart in the scanned map, so they are one zone. The plan's residential program is 1,400 homes in all (PDF p. 80). About 190 acres as drawn inside the site. Adopted plan's designation; approximate, traced from a scanned figure.

properties.label: Educational / civic
properties.source: traced: Mare Island Specific Plan graphics (11x17 figures), City of Vallejo, Figure 3.1 Land Use (revised January 2008), PDF p. 9
properties.note: Public and quasi-public uses: government services, utilities, schools and colleges, cultural facilities (plan §3.2.6, PDF p. 74). Mainly Reuse Area 9 (University Area, Touro University). About 65 acres as drawn inside the site. Adopted plan's designation; approximate, traced from a scanned figure.

properties.label: Open space
properties.source: traced: Mare Island Specific Plan graphics (11x17 figures), City of Vallejo, Figure 3.1 Land Use (revised January 2008), PDF p. 9
properties.note: Parks and open space, including the Community Park (Reuse Area 7) and the Regional Park (Reuse Area 12, 176 acres) (plan §3.4, PDF pp. 87-93). About 231 acres as drawn inside the site. Adopted plan's designation; approximate, traced from a scanned figure.

properties.label: Golf course
properties.source: traced: Mare Island Specific Plan graphics (11x17 figures), City of Vallejo, Figure 3.1 Land Use (revised January 2008), PDF p. 9
properties.note: Reuse Area 11, the existing 18-hole course, 172 acres (plan §3.4.3, PDF p. 93). About 188 acres as drawn inside the site. Adopted plan's designation; approximate, traced from a scanned figure.

properties.label: Restricted open space / former dredge ponds
properties.source: traced: Mare Island Specific Plan graphics (11x17 figures), City of Vallejo, Figure 3.1 Land Use (revised January 2008), PDF p. 9
properties.note: Inactive dredge ponds, restricted to managed wetlands, open space or conservation uses under the Three Party Dredge Pond Agreement (plan §3.2.2, PDF p. 73); 922 acres in Table 3-2 (PDF p. 96). About 368 acres as drawn inside the site. Adopted plan's designation; approximate, traced from a scanned figure.

properties.label: Restricted open space
properties.source: traced: Mare Island Specific Plan graphics (11x17 figures), City of Vallejo, Figure 3.1 Land Use (revised January 2008), PDF p. 9
properties.note: Reuse Area 13 (Open Space/Recreation), a landfill site; about 32 acres of it planned as a city park (plan §3.4.3, PDF p. 93; Table 3-2, PDF p. 96). About 96 acres as drawn inside the site. Adopted plan's designation; approximate, traced from a scanned figure.

properties.label: Industrial
properties.source: traced: Mare Island Specific Plan graphics (11x17 figures), City of Vallejo, Figure 3.1 Land Use (revised January 2008), PDF p. 9
properties.note: Heavy industry, warehouse/distribution, light industrial, construction and equipment services (plan §3.2.9, PDF pp. 78-79). Reuse Areas 1A (North Island Industrial Park), 1B, 5 (Waterfront Industrial Park) and 10A; the text programs 1A as mainly light industrial, warehouse, office and retail (§3.5.1, PDF p. 97), but the figure draws it as industrial. About 408 acres as drawn inside the site. Adopted plan's designation; approximate, traced from a scanned figure.

properties.label: Federal land (Army Reserve, Forest Service)
properties.source: traced: Mare Island Specific Plan graphics (11x17 figures), City of Vallejo, Figure 3.1 Land Use (revised January 2008), PDF p. 9
properties.note: Federal transfer properties, exempt from local land use authority and not subject to the specific plan (plan §3.2.1, PDF p. 73). Category other. About 27 acres as drawn inside the site. Adopted plan's designation; approximate, traced from a scanned figure.

properties.label: Wetlands
properties.source: traced: Mare Island Specific Plan graphics (11x17 figures), City of Vallejo, Figure 3.1 Land Use (revised January 2008), PDF p. 9
properties.note: Wetlands outside the Reuse Areas; Table 3-2 lists 2,865 acres of state-owned wetlands on Mare Island (plan §3.4.3, PDF p. 93; PDF p. 96). About 1,153 acres as drawn inside the site. Adopted plan's designation; approximate, traced from a scanned figure.
